# Kindling α4.1d: Repairing failed learning prerequisites

## What is new

Teaching eligibility follows its personal score; kindness still weighs in that score. Someone with an unmet need and no known remedy can ask a bounded question about personally observed materials. Those trials compete with other useful options and retain their limits and feedback through saves.

Walking now accounts for integer rounding beside solid rock. The ordinary First flake example displays its actual discovery day and keeps a separate cache for each captured camp. Save format remains 11.

## What to try

Start a cold camp, inspect the person's competing reasons and trials, and reopen. Inspect a low-kindness teacher's actual offer and learner reply. Open First flake to see the recorded discovery time; try large text and rotation.

Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase. ## What is rough

Fresh repaired spread PASS: 16 successes from 16 completed seeds meet the 16/20 threshold; both routes and the four-year no-flaking control pass. Fire FAILED: primary 9/20, repeat 2/12; combined 11/32 can reach at most 19/40. Remaining seeds and wet control cannot change failure and stay unrun. The original spread 16/17 and fire 9/15 observations are VOID for acceptance because one camp could not reopen. The rounded-walking cause has a fast regression and repair. P1 remains FAILED: 0.50625 years in 36.41 seconds, 0.834 years/minute against the interim requirement of 5. Approved α4.1e will diagnose worst-case cost. Seasons remain blocked by speed and the fire-chain failure.

The complete repaired routine passed in 375.03 seconds, without an audit. One intermittent Worlds error from α4.1c remains unreproduced for independent review.
